$comment: Lo Shu counts, planes and remedies. Remedies are tradition, not guarantee; gemstone, fasting and donation remedies are off by default (D19). Draft text by Claude, for numerologist review.

blocks.loshu.count.1.missing: No 1: self-expression and confidence in speaking up take conscious effort. Practising saying what you think, kindly and clearly, builds this.
blocks.loshu.count.1.single: One 1: balanced self-expression; able to communicate needs.
blocks.loshu.count.1.double: Two 1s: clear expression and good self-awareness; communicates well.
blocks.loshu.count.1.triple: Three 1s: very talkative and expressive; listening is the balancing skill.
blocks.loshu.count.1.four_plus: Four or more 1s: very strong self-focus and expression; patience with others matters.
blocks.loshu.count.2.missing: No 2: sensitivity and intuition may be underused; patience and gentle listening help.
blocks.loshu.count.2.single: One 2: sensitive and intuitive, with good balance.
blocks.loshu.count.2.double: Two 2s: highly intuitive and perceptive about people.
blocks.loshu.count.2.triple: Three 2s: very sensitive; easily hurt, so emotional boundaries help.
blocks.loshu.count.2.four_plus: Four or more 2s: extreme sensitivity; calm surroundings are important.
blocks.loshu.count.3.missing: No 3: imagination and confidence in learning may need encouragement; reading and creative play help.
blocks.loshu.count.3.single: One 3: a good memory and healthy imagination.
blocks.loshu.count.3.double: Two 3s: very imaginative and creative, with strong ideas.
blocks.loshu.count.3.triple: Three 3s: imagination runs high; grounding ideas in action helps.
blocks.loshu.count.3.four_plus: Four or more 3s: an over-active imagination; focus and routines help.
blocks.loshu.count.4.missing: No 4: order and practical organisation take conscious effort; lists and routines help.
blocks.loshu.count.4.single: One 4: practical and organised, good with hands-on work.
blocks.loshu.count.4.double: Two 4s: very practical and skilled with details and tools.
blocks.loshu.count.4.triple: Three 4s: very hard-working; balance work with rest.
blocks.loshu.count.4.four_plus: Four or more 4s: work can become everything; leisure matters.
blocks.loshu.count.5.missing: No 5: emotional balance and determination can waver; steady goals and movement help.
blocks.loshu.count.5.single: One 5: emotional balance and steady will.
blocks.loshu.count.5.triple: Three 5s: very strong will; pace yourself to avoid rushing.
blocks.loshu.count.5.four_plus: Four or more 5s: intense drive; calm and patience balance it.
blocks.loshu.count.6.missing: No 6: home and family harmony need conscious care; small shared rituals help.
blocks.loshu.count.6.single: One 6: caring, creative and fond of home.
blocks.loshu.count.6.double: Two 6s: strong creativity and care, with some worry about loved ones.
blocks.loshu.count.6.triple: Three 6s: worry about others runs high; trust and letting go help.
blocks.loshu.count.6.four_plus: Four or more 6s: very protective; give loved ones room to grow.
blocks.loshu.count.7.missing: No 7: learning often comes through others' experience; reflection and quiet time help.
blocks.loshu.count.7.single: One 7: thoughtful, with lessons learned through experience.
blocks.loshu.count.7.double: Two 7s: deep and spiritual, sometimes through losses that teach.
blocks.loshu.count.7.triple: Three 7s: very introspective; sharing feelings helps lighten them.
blocks.loshu.count.7.four_plus: Four or more 7s: life brings many deep lessons; spiritual practice supports.
blocks.loshu.count.8.missing: No 8: attention to detail and finishing tasks need practice; checklists help.
blocks.loshu.count.8.single: One 8: methodical and good with detail.
blocks.loshu.count.8.triple: Three 8s: strongly materialistic or restless; balance with simplicity.
blocks.loshu.count.8.four_plus: Four or more 8s: very strong drive for results; rest and reflection help.
blocks.loshu.count.9.missing: No 9: ambition and idealism may need awakening; causes and goals bring energy.
blocks.loshu.count.9.single: One 9: idealistic and humane, with healthy ambition.
blocks.loshu.count.9.double: Two 9s: strong ideals and intelligence; can be critical of others.
blocks.loshu.count.9.triple: Three 9s: very idealistic; practical steps keep dreams grounded.
blocks.loshu.count.9.four_plus: Four or more 9s: very strong ideals; patience with an imperfect world helps.
blocks.loshu.plane.mental.complete: Mental plane 4-9-2 complete: a strong mind, good memory and clear thinking.
blocks.loshu.plane.mental.partial: Mental plane 4-9-2 partly filled: good thinking that grows with study.
blocks.loshu.plane.mental.empty: Mental plane 4-9-2 empty: study and planning need extra care.
blocks.loshu.plane.emotional.complete: Emotional plane 3-5-7 complete: emotional strength and spiritual depth.
blocks.loshu.plane.emotional.partial: Emotional plane 3-5-7 partly filled: feelings are balanced with some effort.
blocks.loshu.plane.emotional.empty: Emotional plane 3-5-7 empty: feelings are kept inside; sharing them helps.
blocks.loshu.plane.practical.complete: Practical plane 8-1-6 complete: very practical and good with material life.
blocks.loshu.plane.practical.partial: Practical plane 8-1-6 partly filled: practical skills are present and can grow.
blocks.loshu.plane.practical.empty: Practical plane 8-1-6 empty: daily practical matters need structure.
blocks.loshu.plane.thought.complete: Thought plane 4-3-8 complete: a strong planner with good ideas.
blocks.loshu.plane.thought.partial: Thought plane 4-3-8 partly filled: plans form well with guidance.
blocks.loshu.plane.thought.empty: Thought plane 4-3-8 empty: planning ahead takes conscious effort.
blocks.loshu.plane.will.complete: Will plane 9-5-1 complete: strong determination and persistence.
blocks.loshu.plane.will.partial: Will plane 9-5-1 partly filled: determination that grows with goals.
blocks.loshu.plane.will.empty: Will plane 9-5-1 empty: motivation needs support from routine and goals.
blocks.loshu.plane.action.complete: Action plane 2-7-6 complete: turns plans into action readily.
blocks.loshu.plane.action.partial: Action plane 2-7-6 partly filled: acts well once confident.
blocks.loshu.plane.action.empty: Action plane 2-7-6 empty: starting takes a push; small steps help.
blocks.loshu.plane.golden.complete: Golden plane 4-5-6 complete: a sign of success and steady progress in material life.
blocks.loshu.plane.golden.partial: Golden plane 4-5-6 partly filled: good prospects with effort.
blocks.loshu.plane.golden.empty: Golden plane 4-5-6 empty: success comes through deliberate, steady work.
blocks.loshu.plane.property.complete: Property plane 2-5-8 complete: favourable for property and lasting assets.
blocks.loshu.plane.property.partial: Property plane 2-5-8 partly filled: assets build steadily over time.
blocks.loshu.plane.property.empty: Property plane 2-5-8 empty: careful saving builds assets over time.

loshu.remedy.1.colour.text: Wear or use blue and black accents, the colours of water, to support the missing 1.

loshu.remedy.1.direction.text: Strengthen the north of your home or room: keep it clean, bright and uncluttered.

loshu.remedy.1.habit.text: Practise speaking up: share one opinion a day clearly and kindly.

loshu.remedy.1.mantra.text: Recite a Sun mantra on Sunday mornings, such as "Om Suryaya Namah".

loshu.remedy.1.fasting.text: Traditionally, a light fast or simple meal on Sundays.

loshu.remedy.1.gemstone.text: Traditionally, ruby is associated with the Sun. Consult an expert before wearing any gemstone.

loshu.remedy.1.donation.text: Traditionally, giving wheat or jaggery on Sundays.

loshu.remedy.2.colour.text: Use earthy yellows and browns to support the missing 2.

loshu.remedy.2.direction.text: Strengthen the south-west: keep it stable, tidy and well-used.

loshu.remedy.2.habit.text: Practise patience: pause and listen fully before responding.

loshu.remedy.2.mantra.text: Recite a Moon mantra on Monday evenings, such as "Om Chandraya Namah".

loshu.remedy.2.fasting.text: Traditionally, a light fast on Mondays.

loshu.remedy.2.gemstone.text: Traditionally, pearl is associated with the Moon. Consult an expert before wearing any gemstone.

loshu.remedy.2.donation.text: Traditionally, giving rice or milk on Mondays.

loshu.remedy.3.colour.text: Use green, the colour of wood, to support the missing 3.

loshu.remedy.3.direction.text: Strengthen the east: let in morning light and keep healthy plants there.

loshu.remedy.3.habit.text: Read or learn something new for a few minutes every day.

loshu.remedy.3.mantra.text: Recite a Jupiter mantra on Thursdays, such as "Om Gurave Namah".

loshu.remedy.3.fasting.text: Traditionally, a light fast on Thursdays.

loshu.remedy.3.gemstone.text: Traditionally, yellow sapphire is associated with Jupiter. Consult an expert before wearing any gemstone.

loshu.remedy.3.donation.text: Traditionally, giving yellow lentils or books on Thursdays.

loshu.remedy.4.colour.text: Use green, the colour of wood, to support the missing 4.

loshu.remedy.4.direction.text: Strengthen the south-east: keep it orderly and well-lit.

loshu.remedy.4.habit.text: Keep a simple daily plan and tick off finished tasks.

loshu.remedy.4.mantra.text: Recite a Rahu mantra on Saturdays, such as "Om Rahave Namah".

loshu.remedy.4.fasting.text: Traditionally, a light fast on Saturdays.

loshu.remedy.4.gemstone.text: Traditionally, hessonite is associated with Rahu. Consult an expert before wearing any gemstone.

loshu.remedy.4.donation.text: Traditionally, giving dark blankets or mustard oil on Saturdays.

loshu.remedy.5.colour.text: Use earthy yellows and browns to support the missing 5.

loshu.remedy.5.direction.text: Keep the centre of the home open, clean and uncluttered.

loshu.remedy.5.habit.text: Move every day and set one clear goal each week.

loshu.remedy.5.mantra.text: Recite a Mercury mantra on Wednesdays, such as "Om Budhaya Namah".

loshu.remedy.5.fasting.text: Traditionally, a light fast on Wednesdays.

loshu.remedy.5.gemstone.text: Traditionally, emerald is associated with Mercury. Consult an expert before wearing any gemstone.

loshu.remedy.5.donation.text: Traditionally, giving green lentils on Wednesdays.

loshu.remedy.6.colour.text: Use white, gold and silver, the colours of metal, to support the missing 6.

loshu.remedy.6.direction.text: Strengthen the north-west: keep it bright and welcoming.

loshu.remedy.6.habit.text: Make time for one shared family activity each week.

loshu.remedy.6.mantra.text: Recite a Venus mantra on Fridays, such as "Om Shukraya Namah".

loshu.remedy.6.fasting.text: Traditionally, a light fast on Fridays.

loshu.remedy.6.gemstone.text: Traditionally, diamond or white sapphire is associated with Venus. Consult an expert before wearing any gemstone.

loshu.remedy.6.donation.text: Traditionally, giving white sweets or clothes on Fridays.

loshu.remedy.7.colour.text: Use white, gold and silver, the colours of metal, to support the missing 7.

loshu.remedy.7.direction.text: Strengthen the west: keep it calm and well-ordered.

loshu.remedy.7.habit.text: Spend ten quiet minutes a day in reflection or meditation.

loshu.remedy.7.mantra.text: Recite a Ketu mantra on Tuesdays, such as "Om Ketave Namah".

loshu.remedy.7.fasting.text: Traditionally, a light fast on Tuesdays.

loshu.remedy.7.gemstone.text: Traditionally, cat's eye is associated with Ketu. Consult an expert before wearing any gemstone.

loshu.remedy.7.donation.text: Traditionally, giving multicoloured cloth or feeding animals on Tuesdays.

loshu.remedy.8.colour.text: Use earthy yellows and browns to support the missing 8.

loshu.remedy.8.direction.text: Strengthen the north-east: keep it clean, light and peaceful.

loshu.remedy.8.habit.text: Finish one task completely before starting the next.

loshu.remedy.8.mantra.text: Recite a Saturn mantra on Saturdays, such as "Om Shanaischaraya Namah".

loshu.remedy.8.fasting.text: Traditionally, a light fast on Saturdays.

loshu.remedy.8.gemstone.text: Traditionally, blue sapphire is associated with Saturn and is considered strong. Consult an expert before wearing any gemstone.

loshu.remedy.8.donation.text: Traditionally, giving black sesame or helping the elderly on Saturdays.

loshu.remedy.9.colour.text: Use red and orange, the colours of fire, to support the missing 9.

loshu.remedy.9.direction.text: Strengthen the south: keep it bright and active.

loshu.remedy.9.habit.text: Take up one cause or goal that matters beyond yourself.

loshu.remedy.9.mantra.text: Recite a Mars mantra on Tuesdays, such as "Om Mangalaya Namah".

loshu.remedy.9.fasting.text: Traditionally, a light fast on Tuesdays.

loshu.remedy.9.gemstone.text: Traditionally, red coral is associated with Mars. Consult an expert before wearing any gemstone.

loshu.remedy.9.donation.text: Traditionally, giving red lentils on Tuesdays.
